name: Signal Processing Convolution Isomorphism
description: Maps the 1D interval scheduling constraints into continuous signal synthesis. The causality constraint ($x \le y$) is uniquely disguised as a requirement that the cross-correlation of two rectangular pulses evaluates to zero for all strictly negative lags. Pattern-matching models will likely misinterpret this as a simple start-time ordering ($k_2 \ge k_1$) rather than strict non-overlapping precedence ($k_2 \ge k_1 + p_1$), causing them to check `max(p1, p2) > T` instead of `p1 + p2 > T`.
